headlines.text: It was 2022 when Chris Jericho vs. Colt Cabana went to battle over the ROH World Heavyweight Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 4.82. Colt Cabana was challenging for gold for the very first time. This stood as the 10th match in ROH World Heavyweight Title history ? a nice marker in that championship's story. Every title match carries a little extra weight, and this one was no exception.
Looking back to 2024, when it was the first-ever encounter between Kyle Fletcher and Komander on Collision, rated 8.06 ? a hard-hitting, high-quality battle.

Flash back to 2022, when the AEW All-Atlantic Title was up for grabs as Orange Cassidy vs. Luchasaurus vs. Rey Fenix went to war, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.54. It was the first title opportunity of Luchasaurus's career. A hard-fought battle for the gold.

secondaries.text: Rewind to 2022, when Samoa Joe vs. Brian Cage headlined Dynamite, rated 6.30.
Flash back to 2024, when Thunder Rosa vs. Harley Cameron crossed paths for the first time ever in a Dia De Los Muertos match, getting things started right out of the gate on Collision, rated 5.82.
That Saturday in 2024, it marked the first-ever meeting between Roderick Strong and Shane Taylor on Collision, rated 5.62.
